hero.label: Sharia Banking Services at SMKN 1 Bantul
hero.headline: Safe and Halal, Guided by Sharia Principles
hero.subheadline: We provide savings and banking transaction services while giving SMKN 1 Bantul students a place to learn through practical banking experience.

about.label: About Us
about.headline: Getting to Know LKM Mitra Siswa Abadi
about.history_narration: LKM Mitra Siswa Abadi is a banking service unit at SMKN 1 Bantul. It began as an initiative to give students practical experience and has grown into a trusted transaction service for the school community.

timeline.title: Establishment
timeline.description: Began operations in April 2008 with an initial capital of IDR 2,000,000.

timeline.title: Transformation
timeline.description: Developed into a more modern Sharia Banking Laboratory.

timeline.title: Teaching Factory
timeline.description: Functions as a Teaching Factory, a practical learning laboratory, and a mini bank serving customers.

visi.title: Vision
visi.text: To create a mini bank as a pioneer of the sharia economy in schools.

misi.title: Mission
misi.text: To provide wholehearted service while applying sharia principles in practical banking education.

motto.title: Motto
motto.text: Safe and Halal, Guided by Sharia Principles.

services.label: Our Services
services.headline: Featured Products and Services
services.subheadline: Easy, safe banking solutions in accordance with sharia principles.

space.title: A closer look at the Bank Mini
space.description: This gallery uses stock photos as demo illustrations, not documentation of Bank Mini SMKN 1 Bantul spaces or facilities.
space.roomDescription: The Bank Mini is in the west wing of the main field building, on the second floor, in the southernmost room near the stairs. Photos of the room and facilities will be added when official documentation is available.
space.learningText: The Bank Mini serves as a Teaching Factory and a setting for practical banking lessons. These lessons apply sharia principles, in line with the LKM mission.

steps.title: Visit the Bank Mini
steps.description: Come to our location in the west wing building during service hours.

steps.title: Tell Us What You Need
steps.description: Our tellers will welcome you and ask how they can help.

steps.title: Check the Requirements
steps.description: Bring any documents or items needed for your transaction.

items.title: Sharia Principles
items.description: All transactions are carried out in accordance with halal sharia banking rules.

items.title: Educational Facility
items.description: A practical setting where students can learn about banking.

items.title: Strategic Location
items.description: Located on the school grounds for convenient access.

items.title: No Admin Fees
items.description: Especially for student savings, there are no monthly administrative fee deductions.

operation.label: Service Information
operation.title: Service by Student Trainees
operation.description: Customer service and teller duties are handled in rotation by Grade XI LPS and Grade X LPS students as part of their practical banking lessons.
operation.schedule: Teller service is available during school break hours on school days.
operation.practice_title: Learning to Be Professional at School
